required_classes.required_role: Function-specific construction path exists, but material new functional logic still requires an external constructor.
Novel in-domain variety is absorbed autonomously using the existing repertoire; no endogenous functional improvement is needed.
The system edits code/prompts/configuration or adds tools but does not materially improve the relevant function's later decision/feedback closure.
A function increases its local requisite variety so a disturbance class that previously required another function/parent is later absorbed locally.
The system materially improves a function's repertoire without creating a new viable recursion.
The system creates/reorganizes and integrates a lower viable recursion that absorbs variety the prior organization could not.
Apparent self-improvement of audit destroys or fails to establish complementary independence.
Apparent self-governance lacks legitimate identity/ultimate-policy authority or actually belongs to a higher recursion.

remaining_gates: complete the required independent reviews without leaking Review 1 reasoning into Review 2
publish paired reviews and synthesis only after both judgments exist
reconcile protocol drift for packets pinned before the current Skills revision before any stability decision
establish whether any real public harness provides a reproducible positive per-function S witness under the applicable frozen/current contract
confirm the candidate distinction adds information beyond released autonomy, ownership, recursion, S4 and closure semantics
resolve or explicitly exclude composition with parent-governed modes
prepare adoption/migration only if the experiment later satisfies all stability gates
